criteria.requirement: Extend actual ResultIter with context management and robust idempotent close. Early break, exhaustion, upstream fetch or row_type conversion failure must release result and dedicated streamed connection without closing shared Database. Detach owned resources before cleanup, attempt both even if cursor close fails, retain the first cleanup error for direct close, and preserve an existing business/conversion exception during cleanup. A closed iterator yields nothing; repeated close is safe. Test real SQLite streamed resources plus synthetic cleanup failures and existing empty/nonstreamed iteration behavior.
Deliver the authorized source changes, public regression tests that fail on the original version, and English compatibility documentation. All frozen native regression tests must pass.

comparison: Accept equivalent implementations according to actual program behavior; do not grade by matching reference text or its length.
